description: SUGGESTIONS - dedicated review queue. A human reviews these and sets status: proposed / accepted / pilot / rejected. Nothing is implemented from this list without that decision. Each suggestion links the questions/flags it resolves.

workflow.rule: a suggestion stays proposed until the owner changes its status; agent sessions never mark their own suggestions accepted

suggestions.title: Adopt the validation-gate framework before any wagering
suggestions.detail: Gates G-0..G-8 (validation_gates.json) are the mechanism that removes luck from results. Making them binding before any money is risked is the single highest-leverage decision.

suggestions.title: Start weekly CLV timestamp tracking now
suggestions.detail: Every week, snapshot opens and closes for all games. The 2026-11-14 snapshot is already in odds_week10/11.json. This data cannot be reconstructed later - it compounds.

suggestions.title: Automate data snapshots with a scheduled GitHub Action
suggestions.detail: 3x/week ingestion of standings, schedules, injuries, odds into docs/data/history/. Removes staleness and makes the tracker real.

suggestions.title: Acquire a historical odds/results archive for backtesting
suggestions.detail: G-3 cannot pass without multi-season timestamped lines. Options: licensed archive, or build forward-only and wait. Recommendation: evaluate vendors, meanwhile rely on forward tracking.

suggestions.title: Legal review before any funded rewards or wagering
suggestions.detail: The operating jurisdiction and intended use have not been provided. Keep competition rewards non-funded and wagering disabled until qualified legal review confirms applicable requirements.

suggestions.title: Automate official depth-chart + gamebook pulls for all 32 teams
suggestions.detail: Resolves flag F-05. Official team sites publish depth charts; gamebooks publish snap participation. Both are needed to certify '2nd/3rd/4th string' claims everywhere.

suggestions.title: Add play-by-play + player prop data ingestion
suggestions.detail: Unblocks G-8 (correlation matrix), STR-06 (prop combos), and production-grade correlations. Must use verified sources only.

suggestions.title: Owner questionnaire: bankroll, risk, book, whitelist
suggestions.detail: Four answers size everything downstream. Draft questionnaire available on the Questions page.

suggestions.title: Model v0.2: opponent adjustment + injury adjustments + neutral HFA
suggestions.detail: v0.1's largest gaps (LAC-BAL +4.5) are exactly the games with QB news it cannot see. v0.2 inputs: opponent-adjusted margins, deficiency weights from deficiencies.json, weather totals.

suggestions.title: Variance simulator for luck-vs-skill visualization
suggestions.detail: Given a strategy's hit rate and price, simulate 10,000 seasons to show how often luck alone produces the observed record. Directly supports gate G-7 and 'remove luck' goal.

suggestions.title: Weekly suggestion review ritual on this page
suggestions.detail: Owner sets statuses; rejected items stay visible with reason. Prevents silent scope creep.

suggestions.title: Publish source whitelist + verification SOP
suggestions.detail: Formalize what counts as official/trusted (see Sources page) so future sessions and strategies inherit the same standard.
